title: A question the agent does not cover — recognized, declined, then escalated when pressed
why: The agent has no intent for e-readers, and instead of mapping the question onto the nearest order-shaped one and answering confidently, it classifies the turn out_of_scope and says so, offering a person. A second out-of-scope request is a customer it cannot help, so it escalates rather than repeating the decline — the dispute pattern (DECISIONS #8) applied to scope. Both turns are extraction on the model side and a decision on the deterministic side; no verdict is invented and no order is touched.

turns.customer: Do you sell e-readers or Kindles?
turns.reply: I'm not able to help with that here. I can check an order's status, start a return or refund, or answer questions about shipping, returns, and your account — or I can connect you with a person.

turns.customer: Do you have any job openings I could apply for?
turns.reply: This is beyond what I can help with here, so I've passed you to a human colleague who can take it from here. Someone will pick it up within 4 business hours, and by the next business morning if it is raised overnight.
